bienvenida.name: Chloe
dialogue: Hi! This is Alejandro's village, and you can see all of it at a glance.
Every villager with an icon above them holds one part of his profile. Tap one and they'll tell you about it.
Rather get straight to it? "Read the profile" up top has everything in one place.
chatter: Hi! Come on in.
Villagers with an icon above them can be tapped.
Press Q to see everything at once.

sobre-mi.name: Katy
dialogue: Come in, come in. Sooner or later, everyone's news reaches the inn.
Alejandro? He's in his final year of Computer Engineering at UCAM.
Take a seat and I'll tell you who he is and what he's looking for.
chatter: Coffee while you look around?
Final year of university, nearly there.
Take a seat, it's cosy in here.

proyectos.name: Bob
dialogue: Step into the market! Only a few stalls so far, but everything you see is real.
Only things that are built, or being built, get sold here.
Have a look at the stalls.
chatter: Every stall here has its own repo.
Everything at this market is the real thing.
That middle stall gets people talking.

backend.name: Jack
dialogue: Mind the sparks: this is where the APIs get forged.
Java and Spring Boot. That's where Alejandro feels at home.
A backend is like a tool: forge it well and it won't let you down halfway through the job.
chatter: This anvil never cools down.
Mind the sparks.
Java and Spring Boot, as always.

datos.name: Mike
dialogue: The good stuff is down below. Data isn't invented: it's mined.
Oracle, PL/SQL and data modelling. That's his deepest seam.
Come on, I'll show you what this mountain is made of.
chatter: This seam looks promising today.
You think more clearly down here.
Oracle and PL/SQL, the deepest seam.

ia.name: Buba
dialogue: Watch your step, everything in here is still growing.
It's the newest part of the village: building AI models into real applications.
You water it little by little and give it time, like anything that grows.
chatter: These plants need watering.
AI needs watering too.
Anything that grows takes patience.
This seed is called machine learning.

certificaciones.name: Bruno
dialogue: Quiet, please, this is a library. More or less.
We keep the certificates here: twelve of them, each one dated.
The Cisco track is complete, all three modules. Not everyone can say that.
chatter: Shh… someone's reading.
Twelve certificates and counting.
The Cisco ones fill a whole shelf.

contacto.name: Fin
dialogue: Shhh, you'll scare them off.
If you've made it all the way to the pond, something caught your eye.
Then cast your line: here's how to reach him.
chatter: Not many bites today.
Email's a kind of net too, right?
Cast your line, he usually answers.

redes.name: Windmill sign
dialogue: "The mill never stops. Neither does the infrastructure."
Underneath, in small print: networking and systems.

aprendiendo.name: Garden sign
dialogue: "What's growing right now."
It's been sown. Nothing to harvest yet, but it's coming up.

sobre-mi.title: About me
sobre-mi.summary: Who I am, what I'm good at and what I'm looking for.
sobre-mi.intro: I'm Alejandro Revilla Blanco, a final-year Computer Engineering student at UCAM (Murcia, Spain).
items: A profile focused on **applied AI**, with a strong foundation in **data** (Oracle, SQL) and **infrastructure** (networking, Linux).
What I do best: getting the data model right before writing the first line of code.
An unusual starting point for a junior: five Oracle certifications and the complete Cisco CCNA track.
AI-related modules: Intelligent Systems, Knowledge Engineering, Databases and Parallel Programming.
I'm looking for an **internship from January 2027** in AI, data or MLOps, in Murcia or remote.
sobre-mi.note: **Schedule:** classes on weekday afternoons. The rest of my time goes on CS50x, English and my own projects.
